episodes.synopsis: Rin thinks back to how her grandpa got her into camping. Meanwhile, the Outdoor Activities Club gets back together for the first time in a while. They build an alcohol stove and plan their next outing.
episodes.title: Where Should We Go Next?

episodes.synopsis: The Outclub girls decide to make a day of camping in Ena's yard to cut Aki's hair and try out their new DIY alcohol stoves. Meanwhile, a new camper takes some smaller trips for herself and starts dreaming big.
episodes.title: Mini Camping and Yard Camping

episodes.synopsis: On their way to meet up with Nadeshiko for a three-girl camping trip, Rin and Ayano bike their way around Ikawa to see the area's impressive array of suspension bridges.
episodes.title: We're Off! Land of Suspension Bridges

episodes.synopsis: Rin and Ayano bike their way up treacherous mountain roads and cross terrifying swinging bridges to make it to the campsite. While she waits for them, Nadeshiko takes in the sights and manages to find a scare of her own...
episodes.title: Hatanagi Attack! Death Road From Hell

episodes.synopsis: Nadeshiko takes it upon herself to prep the campsite, as well as a few treats. When the other girls finally make it, it's time for a campfire and a camp-worthy feast!
episodes.title: Campfires and Beef Feasts

episodes.synopsis: The three-girl camping trip is winding down, but Rin, Ayano, and Nadeshiko are determined to see everything there is to see and eat everything there is to eat before it's over!
episodes.title: See You Again Someday

episodes.synopsis: After Nadeshiko returns from the Oigawa trip, the other Outclub girls recount for her (somewhat dubiously) a spontaneous bus-based camping trip they took while she, Rin, and Ayano were away.
episodes.title: True or Embellished? Retrospective Camping

episodes.synopsis: The Outclub girls share the delicious second half of their (somewhat embellished) camp trip story with Nadeshiko.
episodes.title: The Food Porn Begins!!

episodes.synopsis: Rin takes her first solo camp trip in a while, and Nadeshiko takes an impromptu drive with her sister to see the local cherry blossoms while they're in full bloom.
episodes.title: Touring and Checking Out the Cherry Blossoms

episodes.synopsis: Ena takes Chikuwa for a springtime walk in the park, Nadeshiko manages to sneak some trains into her cherry blossom tour with her sister, and Chiaki tries her hand at solo camping with a savory twist.
episodes.title: Chikuwa, Trains, Chiaki's Solo Camping

episodes.synopsis: Chiaki comes to find out that her surprise encounter with Aoi ahead of their cherry blossom camp trip is thanks to a sudden (and speedy) gift. Meanwhile, Rin joins up with Nadeshiko and her sister to take in some nostalgic scenery.
episodes.title: Scenery From Way Back

episodes.synopsis: The entire gang finally gets together for their much-awaited cherry blossom camp trip, and there's plenty of good food and good memories to go around!
episodes.title: April 2nd: Cherry Blossom Camp Trip
